summary: 2022 systematic review with meta-regression: predicted mean empirical willingness-to-pay = $52,619 per QALY (2018 USD), ~$66,000 in 2024 USD (WTP construct).
source_citation: Willingness to pay for a QALY: systematic review with meta-regression, Eur J Health Econ 23(2), 2022 (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34417905/)

summary: Ryen & Svensson (2015) median willingness-to-pay per QALY = EUR 24,226 (2010), ~$33,000 in 2024 USD (WTP construct).
Ryen & Svensson (2015) meta-analysis (383 estimates): trimmed-mean willingness-to-pay per QALY = EUR 74,159 (2010), ~$100,000 in 2024 USD - an individual WTP construct (vs budget thresholds).
source_citation: Ryen & Svensson, 'The Willingness to Pay for a QALY: A Review of the Empirical Literature', Health Economics 24(10), 2015 (https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1002/hec.3085)
